title: Tokenization of Real-World Assets (RWA)
heading: Transform Physical Assets into Digital, Tradeable Value
description: Tokenization of Real-World Assets enables physical and financial assets such as real estate, gold, commodities, equity, and debt instruments to be represented as secure digital tokens on blockchain. At Haven Tech, we design compliant tokenization frameworks that unlock liquidity, enable fractional ownership, and allow global investors to participate transparently. Our solutions combine smart contracts, KYC/AML layers, and asset-backed structures to ensure trust, regulatory alignment, and long-term scalability.

useCases.title: Real Estate Tokenization
useCases.description: Convert residential and commercial properties into fractional digital tokens, allowing multiple investors to own, trade, and earn yield from property assets without traditional barriers like geography, paperwork, or high capital requirements.

useCases.title: Commodity-Backed Tokens (Gold, Silver, Oil)
useCases.description: Digitize commodities into blockchain-based tokens backed by real reserves. These tokens allow transparent ownership, easier transfer, and improved liquidity compared to traditional commodity trading systems.

useCases.title: Equity & Share Tokenization
useCases.description: Enable startups and enterprises to issue digital shares or equity-linked tokens, simplifying cap table management, improving transparency, and enabling programmable ownership rules through smart contracts.

useCases.title: Private Debt & Sukuk Tokenization
useCases.description: Tokenize debt instruments and Islamic finance products to allow fractional participation, automated profit distribution, and immutable record-keeping for lenders and investors.

useCases.title: Art, Collectibles & IP Assets
useCases.description: Bring liquidity to traditionally illiquid assets like art, collectibles, music rights, or intellectual property by enabling fractional digital ownership and secondary market trading.

useCases.title: Fund & Investment Vehicle Tokenization
useCases.description: Create blockchain-based investment funds where ownership, NAV tracking, and distributions are handled automatically via smart contracts.

howItWorks.description: Identify asset type, valuation model, and ownership structure.
Align token model with regulatory and compliance frameworks.
Define supply, fractional rules, transfer restrictions, and governance.
Build investor onboarding, dashboards, and token management systems.
Launch tokens and track lifecycle, compliance, and performance.

items.question: Is asset tokenization legally compliant?
items.answer: Yes, when structured with proper legal wrappers and jurisdictional compliance.

items.question: Can tokens represent fractional ownership?
items.answer: Yes, assets can be divided into programmable fractional units.

items.question: Can investors trade tokens globally?
items.answer: Yes, subject to compliance rules and jurisdictional restrictions.

items.question: Do you provide investor KYC and AML?
items.answer: Yes, we integrate enterprise-grade KYC/AML systems.

items.question: Which blockchains support RWA tokenization?
items.answer: Solana, XRPL, Polygon, and Ethereum based on use case.
